positions.title: Software Engineer II in Data Architecture
positions.description:
Startups offer a lot of roles to fulfill:
• Architect of a data-science suite and (Extract, Transform, Load) ETL pipeline on AWS
• Automation of data science workflow and machine learning training / inference
• Quantitative analysis / data science, visualization and reporting
• Data Engineer / RESTful API developer
• Improve engineering policies and recruitment

Technologies include:
• AWS: EC2, EKS, Redshift, Batch, S3, Sagemaker, Lambda, ECR, Elastic Inference, Terraform
• TensorFlow, Machine Learning, Keras, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Neural Nets
• NumPy / OpenCV / PIL
• Descriptive, Predictive, Prescriptive Statistics
• Google Cloud (GCP): Datastore, Google Dataflow, BigQuery
• Flask, Postgres, SQLAlchemy, geospatial data, shell scripting, Docker, Neo4J, graphing
• Git, automated testing, continuous integration / delivery (CI/CD)
